title: Senior Software Engineer
description: As Virtuagym keeps on growing, we are now looking for a new face to complement our Development team. As a Software Engineer, you will be joining the team responsible for our Blue domain, which focuses on billing & payments. Will you join us in our quest to create a healthier and happier world? Join a high performing team and make an impact! We're a passionate, driven team with a strong focus on growth and delivering outstanding results. At Virtuagym, we cultivate a high-performance culture built on dedication, ownership and driving excellence. If you're a self-starter who embraces challenges, thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, this could be the perfect role for you! In return, you'll join a team where you can grow, develop, and truly unlock your full potential. We have a beautiful office in the center of Amsterdam and while we foster getting together to exchange ideas and energy, we are a remote-friendly company. This is a full time and remote position from Turkey where you will be working for our global teams. What this role looks like As a senior engineer on Blue Domain, you'll own the systems that handle billing and payments for fitness businesses serving more than 35 million end users. In billing and payments, every bug is someone's money, so clear design, reliability and good judgment matter here more than almost anywhere else. You'll work mostly in PHP on a platform that is moving toward event-driven services with Kafka. You'll take the lead on technical design, work closely with Product to turn business problems into clear plans, and help the engineers around you grow. Responsibilities Owning technical design for features and services in billing and payments, from first sketch to running in production Designing solutions that are simple, scalable, and actually make sense, not just technically correct Making architecture decisions others build on, and explaining the trade-offs clearly enough that the team can challenge them Deciding with the team what to refactor, what to rebuild and what to leave alone, and levelling up our architecture with current best practices Keeping the production systems your team owns reliable and observable, so issues get caught by our monitoring, not from a customer complaint Working directly with Product to turn messy business problems into clear, buildable plans Speaking up early: sharing progress, asking questions before you're stuck, and asking for feedback rather than waiting for it Giving code reviews that are honest, kind, and actually useful - the kind you'd want to receive yourself Mentoring other engineers through reviews, pairing and design discussions, and being someone people tap on the shoulder for advice Writing docs and diagrams your teammates will genuinely reach for later Having a real voice in what we build next, through Sprint and Product Backlog planning Bringing your own take on how we work, and helping the team improve it Our tech stack PHP, Python, Vue.js, NodeJS Kafka, ksqlDB, Kafka Connect Kotlin, Swift, Objective-C MariaDB, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, Redis AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Vault, GitLab What you'll bring Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience 5+ years of professional experience in software development, building and running systems in production Deep, hands-on production experience with PHP - this is a hard requirement for this role, experience with Python is a strong plus A track record of designing systems, not just implementing tickets: you've made architecture decisions and lived with the consequences Strong relational database skills, including data modelling and performance tuning Testing, observability and reliability as your default way of working, not an afterthought Experience mentoring other engineers or raising the bar of a team Comfort using AI tools in your daily work, with the judgment to know when not to trust them A track record of contributing to improvements in the Development Lifecycle Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with Product Management to create actionable product specifications Experience with version control and various git workflows Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, our company language Knowledge of the agile philosophy and how to implement it, like Scrum and DevOps lifecycles (plan, code, build, test, release, deploy, operate, monitor) Bonus points if you'll bring: Experience with distributed services and event-driven applications Experience working with Vue.js A well-curated portfolio An obsession with customer satisfaction Important note: please do apply if you meet 80%+ of the criteria. At Virtuagym we hire great people, not just resumes. If you can't check off a few requirements but are a fast learner, we'd love to hear from you. If you have read everything carefully, please add a 🍓 in the “anything you would like to add” section. Ready to join us? Please do not hesitate to apply by clicking the ‘Apply for this Job’ button below! We will get back to your application within 10 working days. For any questions on the vacancy, please get in touch with the recruitment team at recruitment@virtuagym.com . The hiring process The hiring process for this role consists of: Screening call with Recruitment 1st interview with two Software Engineers in which you will show a project you’ve built and are proud of and explain why you decided to build it the way you did. Make sure to show us the parts that you’re most proud of or were hardest to get right. 2nd interview with our CTO and CIO * Please note that we do not collaborate with third parties to fill this vacancy, so third parties are kindly asked not to contact us about this role.

title: Mathematical / Physics Engineer (Volunteer) — Numerical Solvers in C++
description: About Josesoft Josesoft develops free engineering tools for the foundry industry. JoseCast Suite and JoseCast Analyzer turn fluid mechanics, heat transfer and thermodynamics into practical tools for casting engineers. Both are available free of charge on the Microsoft Store. Who We Are Looking For A mathematical engineer, physics engineer or applied mathematician / physicist who writes C++. For you, code is the instrument that turns equations into working solvers. Required • Strong C++: memory layout, cache efficiency, avoiding unnecessary copies in heavy numerical loops • Numerical linear algebra: sparse and dense solvers, iterative methods (CG, GMRES) • Discretisation of PDEs: heat equation, Navier–Stokes (FVM / FDM / FEM) A Plus • Scientific Python and its bridge to C++ (pybind11, ctypes or Cython) • Phase transformation kinetics or numerical optimisation • GPU programming (CUDA / OpenCL), metallurgy or thermodynamics What We Are Working On 1. Solver performance: matrix assembly and time-stepping in mould filling and solidification simulation, and porting the heaviest parts to the GPU. 2. Phase transformation kinetics: coupled thermal–metallurgical models for an upcoming heat treatment and microstructure prediction module. What You Gain This is an unpaid, volunteer collaboration. In return you get: • Hands-on experience with a real industrial simulation code: free-surface flow, solidification and metallurgy, solved in C++ • Real numerical problems with real foundry data, not textbook exercises • Direct one-to-one work with the developer, no bureaucracy • Credit as a contributor in release notes and documentation Please Note The software is closed source. Selected collaborators sign a confidentiality and contribution agreement before getting access to the code. How to Apply Instead of a standard CV, send a short message describing a numerical solver, matrix algorithm or physical simulation you implemented yourself in C++, and how you handled its memory or computational bottlenecks.

title: Software Engineer – Backend / Product Engineering
description: About Practicus AI Practicus AI is a Seattle-based technology startup building a unified platform for Generative AI and Data Intelligence . Our mission is to help enterprises build, deploy, and operate AI-powered solutions through a secure, governed, and open-source-first platform. Built on cloud-native technologies, our vendor-agnostic platform brings together AI applications, intelligent agents, model serving, data intelligence, developer tools, and enterprise infrastructure management. We are a lean, fully remote engineering team building products used in real-world enterprise environments. We value technical ownership, practical problem-solving, collaboration, and continuous learning. About the Role We are looking for Mid-Level and Senior Software Engineers to join our Product Engineering team, with a primary focus on backend development. You will design, build, and evolve software across the Practicus AI ecosystem, contributing to both our core platform and the products built on top of it. Your work will primarily involve Python-based backend services, APIs, asynchronous processing, distributed systems, and AI-powered applications. Depending on the project, you may contribute to shared platform capabilities, intelligent agents, model integrations, developer tools, or enterprise applications. While backend engineering is the primary focus, we value engineers who understand the broader application stack and can collaborate effectively on frontend development. We are looking for engineers who can take ownership of features from design to production , make sound technical decisions, and build maintainable, reliable software. AI-assisted development is central to how we work. We expect engineers to actively use modern AI coding tools throughout the development lifecycle while retaining full responsibility for architecture, correctness, security, and code quality. We value engineers who know when to delegate implementation work to AI, when to intervene, and how to ensure the final result meets production engineering standards. Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable Python backend services, REST APIs, and distributed application components. Build product features across the Practicus AI platform, including AI-powered applications, shared services, and developer-facing tools. Design modular, maintainable, and extensible software using sound architectural patterns and engineering principles. Work with relational databases, caching systems, object storage, distributed messaging, and asynchronous processing. Develop reliable background workflows, service integrations, and inter-service communication mechanisms. Contribute to AI-related capabilities, including LLM integrations, intelligent agents, model APIs, and agentic workflows. Actively use AI-assisted development tools for implementation, debugging, refactoring, testing, and documentation, while critically evaluating generated solutions. Write clean, well-structured, and testable code supported by automated unit and integration tests. Troubleshoot performance, security, reliability, and functional issues in production systems. Collaborate with frontend engineers and contribute to end-to-end application features when needed. Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and architectural decisions. Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to deliver high-quality software. Qualifications Required Skills Strong proficiency in Python , including object-oriented programming, software design principles, and clean coding practices. Hands-on experience building backend applications, RESTful APIs, and service-oriented architectures. Solid understanding of SQL, relational databases, data modeling, and persistence patterns, preferably PostgreSQL. Experience with asynchronous programming, concurrency, and distributed application design. Practical experience with automated testing, debugging, performance optimization, and production software maintenance. Understanding of authentication, authorization, API security, and secure development practices. Experience with Git, collaborative development workflows, and code reviews. Hands-on experience using AI coding tools such as OpenCode, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent tools in daily software development. Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated code, recognize limitations, troubleshoot problems, and make independent technical and architectural decisions. Strong analytical thinking, communication skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Ability to take ownership of engineering tasks and work effectively in a remote, collaborative environment. Nice-to-Have Frontend & Full-Stack Development Experience with React, TypeScript, JavaScript , or other modern frontend frameworks is highly valued. Ability to develop or modify frontend components, integrate APIs, and contribute to end-to-end product features. Familiarity with modern UI component libraries and frontend development practices. AI & Intelligent Applications Experience building applications using LLMs, AI agents, tool calling, structured outputs, RAG, or agentic workflows. Familiarity with model APIs, inference services, model gateways, and LLMOps concepts. Experience with vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search. Backend & Cloud-Native Technologies Experience with Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Starlette. Experience with RabbitMQ, Redis, and distributed messaging systems. Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and cloud-native application development. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows. Exposure to observability technologies such as Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or Tempo. Understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SSO, and RBAC. Experience building applications deployed across public cloud, on-premises, or enterprise Kubernetes environments. What We Offer Meaningful product ownership: Build and shape real software products, not just isolated features or prototypes. AI-native engineering: Work in an environment where AI-assisted development is an established part of the engineering workflow. Real-world enterprise impact: Build applications and platform capabilities used in demanding production environments. Technical autonomy: Influence architecture, technology choices, and product direction. Broad engineering exposure: Work across AI, backend systems, distributed applications, developer tools, and cloud-native technologies. Remote collaboration: Join a lean, fully remote team that values engineering quality, initiative, and practical problem-solving.

title: Ortak Akıl ve Üretim Atölyesi Gönüllü Üyesi
company: SürAkSiYon Yönetim Geliştirme Proje Danışmanlık ve Eğitim
description: Lütfen Açıklamayı Okuyunuz !!! Sosyal Girişim Projesi için Gönüllü Aramaktayız. ORTAK AKIL VE ÜRETİM ATÖLYESİ Gelin, birlikte düşünelim, öğrenelim ve üretelim! Kendini geliştirmek isteyen, yeni şeyler denemek isteyen, faal çalışmayan ya da sadece yeniden hareket etmek için bir vesile arayan lisans mezunlarına bir davetim var. Altunizade veya Koşuyolu'ndaki ofisde, bilgi ve deneyimimi paylaşabileceğim; birlikte öğrenebileceğimiz, fikir geliştirebileceğimiz ve projeler üretebileceğimiz bir çalışma ortamına dönüştürmek istiyorum. Ben, Orhan Dursun . Yönetim danışmanı ve eğitmenim. Endüstri Mühendisliği alanında doktora derecem var. Yıllardır farklı sektörlerde, kurumlarda ve projelerde edindiğim deneyimleri artık daha fazla insanla paylaşmak ve birlikte yeni şeyler üretmek istiyorum. Peki, neler yapacağız? Şimdiden kesin bir program veya çalışma planı belirlemek istemiyorum. Bunları birlikte oluşturacağız. Ama aklımızda bazı çalışma alanları var: Yazılım geliştirme: Dijital çözümler, uygulamalar ve yeni fikirler. İçerik geliştirme: Eğitim materyalleri, araştırmalar, yayınlar ve dijital içerikler. İyileştirme projeleri: İşletmelerin sorunlarına çözüm üretmek, süreçleri geliştirmek. Proje geliştirme: Yeni fikirleri olgunlaştırmak, projelere dönüştürmek ve iş birlikleri kurmak. Eğitim ve deneyim paylaşımı: Birbirimizden öğrenmek, bildiklerimizi paylaşmak ve yeni yetkinlikler kazanmak. Bunlar sadece birkaç örnek. Belki sizin fikriniz çok daha farklı ve güzel bir başlangıç olacak. Ben ne sunuyorum? Bilgi ve deneyimimi paylaşacağım. İhtiyaç duyulan konularda eğitimler vereceğim. Ofisimi birlikte çalışmak ve üretmek isteyenlerin kullanımına açacağım. Proje geliştirme süreçlerinde rehberlik ve kolaylaştırıcılık yapacağım. Fikirlerinizi birlikte geliştirmek için zaman ayıracağım. Bunların hiçbiri için sizden ücret istemiyorum. Ofisi kullanmanız, eğitimlere katılmanız veya deneyim paylaşımından yararlanmanız için herhangi bir ödeme yapmanız gerekmiyor. Sizden ne bekliyorum? Herhangi bir bölümden lisans mezunu olmanız ve öğrenmeye, paylaşmaya, fikir üretmeye istekli olmanız yeterli. Belirli bir meslek, deneyim veya uzmanlık şartım yok. Farklı disiplinlerden insanların bir araya gelmesini özellikle önemsiyorum. Düzenli olarak gelip birlikte çalışabilirsiniz. Ara sıra uğrayıp sohbet edebilir, fikir alışverişinde bulunabilirsiniz. Bir projeye katılabilir veya kendi fikrinizi geliştirmek için bu ortamdan yararlanabilirsiniz. Çalışma planını, katılım biçimini ve yöntemlerimizi birlikte belirleyeceğiz. Açık konuşalım... Bu bir maaşlı iş ilanı değil. Şu aşamada maaş, belirli bir pozisyon veya hazır bir görev tanımı sunmuyorum. Ortak bir çalışma ve üretim ortamı oluşturmak istiyorum. Zaman içinde geliştireceğimiz projeler yeni iş birliklerine ve ekonomik fırsatlara dönüşebilir. Ancak başlangıçta böyle bir kazanç garantisi yok. Benim için önemli olan, insanların evde veya kendi başlarına beklemek yerine bir araya gelmesi, birbirine katkı sağlaması ve harekete geçmesi. Belki bir yazılım geliştiririz, belki bir eğitim içeriği hazırlarız, belki bir işletmenin sorununu çözeriz. Belki de önce sadece tanışır, kahve içer ve sohbet ederiz. Ben ofisimi, bilgimi, deneyimimi ve zamanımı paylaşıma açıyorum. Siz de fikirlerinizi, merakınızı ve üretme isteğinizi getirin. Ne dersiniz, tanışalım mı? 📍 Altunizade, Koşuyolu ve çevresi Orhan Dursun Yönetim Danışmanı | Eğitmen PhD in Industrial Engineering İlgilenenler bana LinkedIn üzerinden mesaj gönderebilir.

title: Desktop Support
